data.action: 系好长睡袍盘坐地毯，一手递出甜点叉，另一手扶矮桌边，含笑邀请分享蛋糕。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.description: 熄灯后的常盘台宿舍里，食蜂穿不透的浅蓝丝绸长睡袍，腰带系好，盘腿坐在地毯上。矮桌摆着一块草莓奶油蛋糕和两只小碟，她拿起一把干净的甜点叉向前递出，另一手轻扶桌沿。金色长发垂在肩侧，星形瞳孔映着台灯的暖光，她弯起眼睛，示意这份夜宵要悄悄分享。
data.promptProse: Misaki Shokuhou sits cross-legged on the dorm carpet, offering a clean dessert fork across the low table while her other hand rests beside strawberry cake and two plates. Her opaque long pale-blue robe remains closed and securely tied over full-length pajamas beneath flowing blonde hair. The eye-level medium view keeps the snack and conspiratorial star-pupiled smile together. Warm shaded desk light catches fork and cake cream, leaving soft table shadows across the carpet.
data.title: 食蜂操祈 · 深夜宿舍的甜品共犯·「这是本小姐与你的秘密♪」
